chapter: Male Genitourinary, Andrology and Urologic Pathology

profiles.name: Prostate adenocarcinoma
profiles.notes: Invasive acinar carcinoma; Gleason/ISUP grade group and TNM stage; absent basal cells in invasive glands. PSA alone is nonspecific; localized surveillance/curative management vs systemic ADT and intensification depending on risk and disease state.

profiles.name: Benign prostatic hyperplasia
profiles.notes: Nonmalignant transition-zone nodular hyperplasia, DHT-mediated growth and alpha1 smooth muscle tone; urinary symptoms do not prove obstruction. Alpha blockers or 5-alpha reductase inhibitors for selected patients, procedural management when clinically indicated.

profiles.name: Testicular seminoma
profiles.notes: GCNIS-related germinoma usually OCT4/SOX17/CD117-positive and AFP-normal. Inguinal orchiectomy and stage-tailored surveillance/chemotherapy/radiotherapy; elevated AFP suggests nonseminomatous elements.

profiles.name: Testicular embryonal carcinoma
profiles.notes: Primitive nonseminomatous GCNIS-related cancer; OCT4/SOX2/CD30 expression and early lymphovascular invasion; mixed tumor recognition, serum markers and stage determine cisplatin-based treatment.

profiles.name: Testicular torsion
profiles.notes: Spermatic cord twisting and acute ischemia; clinical high suspicion mandates immediate surgical exploration without delaying for sonography.

profiles.name: Acute epididymitis
profiles.notes: Epididymal inflammation/infection, subacute unilateral pain; torsion exclusion is first; STI and enteric risks guide NAAT, urine testing and antibiotics.

profiles.name: Acute bacterial prostatitis
profiles.notes: Abrupt febrile infection of prostate with urinary symptoms; urine/blood cultures, no vigorous massage, risk-sensitive antibiotic therapy and drainage of significant retention.

profiles.name: Penile squamous cell carcinoma
profiles.notes: Biopsy-confirmed invasive SCC; HPV-associated vs HPV-independent pathway; primary lesion stage and inguinal nodal status determine prognosis and penile-preserving versus radical therapy.

profiles.name: Male urethral stricture disease
profiles.notes: Spongiofibrosis and lumen narrowing; map by retrograde urethrography and/or cystoscopy; appropriate urethroplasty may be more durable than serial endoscopic treatments.

profiles.name: Fournier gangrene
profiles.notes: Necrotizing fasciitis of perineum/genitalia with risk of sepsis; resuscitation, immediate empiric broad antimicrobials and early repeated surgical debridement; do not postpone for imaging.

profiles.name: Varicocele
profiles.notes: Pampiniform venous dilation/reflux linked to subfertility in some men; select repair for clinically palpable varicocele with infertility and abnormal semen, not asymptomatic subclinical imaging-only findings.

profiles.name: Peyronie disease
profiles.notes: Acquired tunica albuginea fibrosis leading to curvature/hinge; active versus stable disease directs nonoperative and procedural options.

profiles.name: High-grade prostatic intraepithelial neoplasia
profiles.notes: NONINVASIVE pre-neoplastic duct/gland epithelium with intact basal layer; focal isolated finding does not itself justify automatic immediate repeat biopsy.

profiles.name: Germ cell neoplasia in situ of testis
profiles.notes: Intratubular NONINVASIVE precursor of most postpubertal testicular GCTs; OCT4/PLAP positivity interpreted with morphology; specialist fertility-informed treatment decisions.
